recentPosts.text: Foreclosure auction Before and After - Won for 136k, Rehab 70k, UA for 360k
I've lost $100K+ at foreclosure auctions by making the same mistakes over and over. Here are the lessons that finally made me money:

20 years ago, my partner and I bought our first rental property together. Today, I'm finally letting it go. Both tenants moved out at the same time. We pulled 3 cash-out refinances over the years. It's been incredible cash flow. But there's $350K+ in equity sitting there and...

Stop overpaying for "turnkey." You're paying $100k+ markup to avoid work that takes 6 months. Auction it, rehab it, keep the equity. Slower? Yes. Richer? Absolutely. #RealEstate #RealEstateInvesting #ForeclosureAuction
We thought we found the deal of a lifetime at the auction. Bought it, sealed it, thought we were golden. Spoiler: we weren't. Here's what went wrong

actionableTips: Long-form videos currently get 150-400 views. Titles with specific dollar amounts perform 2-3x better.
Best-performing content features real auction experiences with specific numbers.
Videos over 10 minutes tend to perform better for this niche.
Shift from 7 shorts/week to 2-3 long-form + 3-4 shorts.
Thumbnails should consistently show the property + price overlay.
Use series playlists (Foreclosure Auction Diary, Auction Day).
Hook viewers in first 30 seconds with the outcome/result.
